correctness.rationale: For all L>=0, n<2^L and j>=0, Kummer identifies nu_2(binomial(5n,2n)) with binary carry-outs in 2n+3n. The three-bit state (previous n bit, carry forming 3n=n+2n, carry adding 3n+2n) has exactly the stated two transitions per input digit; only the second carry is weighted. Four forced zero-input steps clear every one of the eight states; the terminal weights (1,1,1,t,t,t,1,t^2) include all residual carries. The length-L transfer thus enumerates each n exactly once. Formal matrix inversion and coefficient extraction yield F_0=(1+z^3)/(1-z-z^2+z^3-z^4) and F_1=z(1-z^2)^2/(1-z-z^2+z^3-z^4)^2. In a newly written independent Python/SymPy checker the transfer and terminal weights were rebuilt, both rational identities cancelled exactly, and all histograms for L=0..13 (sum 2^L=16383 inputs) agreed with independent digit sums s_2(n)+s_2(3n)-s_2(5n). Git tree SHA-1 was independently reconstructed from all seven actual entries and matched the frozen assignment. The unrestricted theorem follows from Kummer plus state induction, not from finite tests.
residual_risks: The symbolic 8-by-8 elimination was independently checked using SymPy rather than a handwritten closed-form elimination; exact cancellation is sufficient for the finite polynomial identity.
Directly enumerated indices stop at L=13; the all-L statement is proved by the state argument.

value.rationale: The 2-adic valuation of binomial(5n,2n) along a fixed proportional ray is a natural digital-arithmetic statistic, and exactly counting all fibre multiplicities over every dyadic interval is a definite infinite-family invariant that a number-theory researcher could reuse. The two distinct carry mechanisms produce nontrivial valuation-one counts and a squared quartic generating denominator, beyond the earlier parity/zero layer. The work explicitly computes this natural case rather than presenting a generic relabeling, a few sampled values or an unsupported major breakthrough. No generic arbitrary-slope theorem or asymptotic universality is asserted.
residual_risks: The work is a specific exact slope invariant, not a new general transfer-matrix theorem; its utility is structural and arithmetic rather than a demonstrated downstream application.
